scope: Read-only diagnosis of one existing hosted run; no workflow rerun/cancel or repository modification.

The job invokes the original public_v3_multiprocess test directly, without the pq-root-v3 feature or the new V3 component runner. This failure is in the retained original gate, not a failed new V3 test invocation.
causality_limit: This observation does not prove that V3 has no indirect performance impact, nor that host resource limits are the sole cause. No controlled base/head comparison on the same hosted machine was performed. Do not label the overall native campaign successful.
